news.title: ASX Runners of the Week: Rincon, Infinity & Titomic
news.snippet: The Bulls N’ Bears ASX Runner of the Week is… Rincon Resources, after unveiling high-grade copper and gold from surface at its Telfer South project in WA’s Paterson Province.

news.title: Auric launches drilling blitz at newly acquired WA gold play
news.snippet: Auric Mining launched a 13,000m drill blitz at its 102,000-ounce Union Jack gold project in WA, chasing resource growth and potential ore for its nearby Burbanks mill.

news.title: Metals rebound, AI bounce sends sharemarket higher
news.snippet: Shares ended the week higher, clawing back some of the previous week’s sell-off after a bounce in artificial intelligence stocks reinvigorated metals prices.

news.title: Manhattan scores $30M Canadian gold farm-in
news.snippet: Manhattan Gold secures a $30.2m Canadian farm-in deal, with partner USFM funding $28m exploration for an 85% stake in its Hook Lake gold-copper project in Nunavut.

news.title: Implosion: The downfall of China’s money king
news.snippet: Tang Ning built his company into one of China’s most trusted wealth managers. But it has all come crashing down.

news.title: Drill bit pierces Nullarbor cover in Artemis, Red Metal copper hunt
news.snippet: Red Metal Ltd’s partner Artemis has hit basement rock in the first-ever test of the massive Sharon Dam magnetic and gravity anomaly on the Nullarbor Plain, with drilling ongoing.

news.snippet: Barkly Rare Earths has unveiled a five-fold resource increase at its namesake NT project to 205Mt of rare earths material, including 140,000 tonnes of high-value magnet rare earths.
